svg.text: The POC in one picture: what we did, in order (2026-11-22/23)

g.text: New project, budget alert, APIs, gcloud profile; copy of Google's GA4 sample as one partitioned table (4.3 M rows, 92 days).
Google auto-creates entries with schema (109 nested fields) but no meaning: no overview, no column descriptions, no glossary.
Needed 2 patches to run; writes one cited Markdown overview per entry; two runs share 0 sentences; dataset-level SQL wrong 8/8.
Made-up policy doc + Google docs + 12 golden-SQL eval. 29 min run, 9 proposed pages, eval 67% to 100%, every policy fact landed.
Reviewed per page (removed 1, approved 8). Read back as OKF files and through kcmd's MCP server.
OKF moved out of Google (v0.3). kcmd push writes directly (no review, not atomic); change-request API is reviewed and
Agent test: a local LangGraph NL-to-SQL agent
15 questions x 3 setups. No context 6/15; KC context as OKF files 10/15; via kcmd MCP 12/15. Held-out policy questions: 0/3 vs 3/3.
Per capability: use Google, needs a custom piece, or combine. Plus a checklist for comparing with home-grown context agents.

svg.text: Cost: about USD 1 of BigQuery scans in total (inside the free tier); Studio tokens free in Preview; Gemini tokens for steps 2 and 5 billed by Vertex (not priced here).
